name: frontend-monitor-sdk
title: Web monitor SDK
description: Browser-side monitoring (PV/AJAX/resource/errors) via @devbie/frontend-monitor-sdk. Scaffolds a client component for your root layout. Heartbeat wiring is NOT included — it is handled by the template's instrumentation.ts.
postInstall: Add <FrontendMonitor /> inside your root layout <body> (src/app/layout.tsx), then set NEXT_PUBLIC_FRONTEND_MONITOR_ENDPOINT (report endpoint URL) and NEXT_PUBLIC_FRONTEND_MONITOR_TOKEN. The component is a no-op until both env vars are present.
